title: DropBack: refund the price drop, keep the sale
instructions: Voice: a confident, warm product-launch narrator. Pace: brisk but clear, like a polished startup demo video. Short natural pauses at full stops. Slight emphasis on the dollar amounts and on the product name DropBack.

scenes.say: [confident] This is DropBack… powered by PayPal and Channel3. When a price drops, your customer keeps the item… and you keep the sale.
scenes.vo: This is DropBack powered by PayPal and Channel3. When a price drops, your customer keeps the item and you keep the sale.

scenes.say: [serious] Last year, US shoppers returned $890 billion of goods.
scenes.caption: Last year, US shoppers returned *$890 billion* of goods.

visual.label: *$890 billion* in US retail returns, 2024
visual.source: NRF & Happy Returns, 2024 Consumer Returns report

scenes.vo: Last year, US shoppers returned $890 billion of goods.

scenes.say: Some returns aren't about the product. A shopper pays $398… days later, it's $298 elsewhere. So they send it back… and buy it again.
scenes.caption: Some returns *aren't about the product.* / Pays *$398,* days later it's *$298* elsewhere. / So they *send it back, and buy it again.*
scenes.vo: Some returns aren't about the product. A shopper pays $398 days later, it's $298 elsewhere. So they send it back and buy it again.

scenes.say: [thoughtful] For the merchant, that return costs about $291… shipping, restocking, a markdown, and the lost sale… to avoid a $100 gap.
scenes.caption: For the merchant, that return costs *about $291:* / shipping, restocking, markdown, *the lost sale,* / to avoid a *$100* gap.
scenes.vo: For the merchant, that return costs about $291 shipping, restocking, a markdown, and the lost sale to avoid a $100 gap.

scenes.say: [warmly] DropBack plugs into a merchant's existing PayPal checkout. Channel3 finds the exact product's live price… and its history. AI weighs a refund against a return. And the merchant refunds the difference… in one click.
scenes.caption: DropBack plugs into a merchant's *existing PayPal checkout.* / *Channel3* finds the exact product's live price and history. *AI* weighs refund vs. return. / The merchant *refunds the difference in one click.*
scenes.vo: DropBack plugs into a merchant's existing PayPal checkout. Channel3 finds the exact product's live price and its history. AI weighs a refund against a return. And the merchant refunds the difference in one click.

scenes.say: [upbeat] Here it is, live in PayPal Sandbox. A merchant signs up… and creates a workspace for their store.
scenes.caption: Live in *PayPal Sandbox.* / A merchant signs up and *creates a workspace* for their store.
scenes.vo: Here it is, live in PayPal Sandbox. A merchant signs up and creates a workspace for their store.

scenes.say: They connect their own PayPal account… and paid orders flow in by webhook.
scenes.caption: They connect *their own PayPal account;* / paid orders *flow in by webhook.*
scenes.vo: They connect their own PayPal account and paid orders flow in by webhook.

scenes.say: They choose which retailers to price-match… and turn protection on.
scenes.caption: They choose which *retailers to price-match,* / and *turn protection on.*
scenes.vo: They choose which retailers to price-match and turn protection on.

scenes.say: Now, a shopper buys Sony headphones for $398… protected for 14 days.
scenes.caption: A shopper buys *Sony headphones* for *$398,* / protected for *14 days.*
scenes.vo: Now, a shopper buys Sony headphones for $398 protected for 14 days.

scenes.say: They check out with PayPal. DropBack creates the order through PayPal's Server SDK.
scenes.caption: They check out *with PayPal.* / The order is created through *PayPal's Server SDK.*
scenes.vo: They check out with PayPal. DropBack creates the order through PayPal's Server SDK.

scenes.say: The buyer approves in PayPal… and the payment is captured.
scenes.caption: The buyer *approves in PayPal,* / and the payment is *captured.*
scenes.vo: The buyer approves in PayPal and the payment is captured.

scenes.say: Three days later, the buyer opens their order… and checks the live price.
scenes.caption: *Three days later,* the buyer opens their order / and checks the *live price.*
scenes.vo: Three days later, the buyer opens their order and checks the live price.

scenes.say: Channel3 finds the exact model, new and in stock: $298 at Beach Camera, a retailer this store matches. That's $100 less.
scenes.caption: *Channel3* finds the exact model, new and in stock: / *$298* at *Beach Camera.* That's *$100 less.*
scenes.vo: Channel3 finds the exact model, new and in stock: $298 at Beach Camera, a retailer this store matches. That's $100 less.

scenes.say: And it's verified by Channel3, with 46 days of price history. It held steady at $319.99… so this is a real drop.
scenes.caption: *Verified by Channel3:* 46 days of price history. / It held steady at $319.99, so this is a *real drop.*
scenes.vo: And it's verified by Channel3, with 46 days of price history. It held steady at $319.99 so this is a real drop.

scenes.say: Instead of sending it back, they ask for the difference… and it goes straight to the merchant.
scenes.caption: Instead of sending it back, they *ask for the difference,* / and it goes *straight to the merchant.*
scenes.vo: Instead of sending it back, they ask for the difference and it goes straight to the merchant.

scenes.say: On the merchant side, every request lands in an AG Grid queue.
scenes.caption: Every request lands in an *AG Grid* queue.
scenes.vo: On the merchant side, every request lands in an AG Grid queue.

scenes.say: The case report opens on that Channel3 evidence. Return risk: 57 percent. A return would cost $291… so refunding $100 saves about $65. [firm] And policy limits are never left to the AI.
scenes.caption: The case report opens on the *Channel3 evidence.* Return risk: *57%.* / A return would cost *$291*, so refunding $100 saves *about $65.* / *Policy limits are never left to the AI.*
scenes.vo: The case report opens on that Channel3 evidence. Return risk: 57 percent. A return would cost $291 so refunding $100 saves about $65. And policy limits are never left to the AI.

scenes.say: The merchant approves. PayPal refunds $100, with an idempotency key, so it can never pay twice.
scenes.caption: The merchant approves. PayPal refunds *$100,* / with an *idempotency key,* so it can *never pay twice.*
scenes.vo: The merchant approves. PayPal refunds $100, with an idempotency key, so it can never pay twice.

scenes.say: [warmly] The buyer sees the refund right away… they keep the headphones, and the merchant keeps the sale.
scenes.caption: The buyer sees the *refund right away.* / They keep the headphones; the merchant *keeps the sale.*
scenes.vo: The buyer sees the refund right away they keep the headphones, and the merchant keeps the sale.

scenes.say: Under the hood: the APIMatic-generated PayPal Server SDK, an MCP server for AI agents… and it's deployed on Render.
scenes.caption: Under the hood: the *APIMatic-generated PayPal Server SDK,* / an *MCP server* for AI agents, *deployed on Render.*
scenes.vo: Under the hood: the APIMatic-generated PayPal Server SDK, an MCP server for AI agents and it's deployed on Render.

scenes.say: [confident] Fewer returns. Proof from Channel3. And the money stays on PayPal.

items.title: Fewer *returns*
items.sub: refund the gap, not the box

scenes.vo: Fewer returns. Proof from Channel3. And the money stays on PayPal.

scenes.say: DropBack, by Sartech Labs. Built on PayPal… powered by Channel3.
scenes.vo: DropBack, by Sartech Labs. Built on PayPal powered by Channel3.
